text_block_list.text: —Summer training camp starts today!

For a while, they will be staying at a special facility,
spending day after day fully immersed in training.
As soon as we arrived at the training lodge, we tossed our bags into our rooms and headed straight for the beach with Nakayama Festa.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: So, what's on the menu this time?
choice_data_list: For now, maybe we should focus on building stamina.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Fine by me. Let's use as much of
this space as we can.
choice_data_list: Come to think of it, about the teacher...

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
...So you were in touch with them too.
Well, figures.

Previously,
whenever I sent a message to her teacher via the app,
I would always get a reply that very same day.

Lately, however, the replies took one day, then three days, then a week...
The intervals between responses were gradually growing longer and longer.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: ...The contents have gotten shorter, too.

Feeling too sick even to type a reply...
A bad premonition crosses my mind.
choice_data_list: Still, they're sure to watch your races.
Still, I'm sure they'll be watching your race.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
...Your smile is way too stiff.
Don't go trying to encourage me when you're clearly not used to it.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Kyaaah, El-senpaaai♪

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Grass! It's been since last year
that we got to spend summer camp together, deesu!
Surrounded by the Umamusume was El Condor Pasa. Standing next to her was Grass Wonder, one of the Golden Generation.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
I thought you would be
traveling the world by now.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: And yet, why are you still in the country?

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Ah, El Condor Pasa-san!
Could we get a quick comment from you!?

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
Have you heard that that Oaks winner is challenging the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe next!?
Please give her a comment as her senior—

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
No! I shall politely decline!
Before all the hustle, bustle, and clamor starts,
I'm going to make a quick getaway!!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: El, we're not done talking—

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Grass! El has been searching for so long!
A rough diamond worthy of succeeding me!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
And in this year's Classic circuit!
That light finally reached El's eyyyyes!!

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Ah! El Condor Pasa-san!
*sigh*... And I was really hoping to take a picture with her, too.

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text: "Still, they said the Classic campaign! A diamond in the rough to carry the mantle... It's gotta be that rising star!"

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: "...The media doesn't care about me at all anymore, either."

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Well, our backs are still against the wall regardless.
This thrilling gamble is far from over.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Now then, let's make them turn their eyes back toward us once more.
Summer training camp with Nakayama Festa has begun!
